name: War-Awoken Blazing Nova
name_jp: 戦醒ブレイジングノヴァ
effects:
Tactical Awoken Mode & +500 ATK to user, Quick ATB 3 to user if Fina/Lasswell is in party
Tactical Awoken Mode: Fire/Earth Ability Boost, Triplecast Fire/Earth, Unlimited Fire/Earth Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Fire/Earth Abilities, Fire/Earth Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Fire/Earth Abilities; Ends after using 8 Fire/Earth abilities
TP Max: AOE Fire/NE or Earth/NE physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1 under En-Fire or En-Earth
